name: Adaptive Spherical Harmonics Band Adjustment
definition: A method to reduce memory by assigning each Gaussian primitive only the necessary number of Spherical Harmonics (SH) bands (0 to 3), rather than storing all bands for all primitives.
summary: Adaptive Spherical Harmonics Band Adjustment optimizes memory in 3D Gaussian Splatting by pruning higher-order bands for primitives with simple view-dependent appearance, unlike methods targeting spatial redundancy.
